ink.purpose: Every outline, text stroke and translucent HUD backing.

wood-light.purpose: Top stop of the light wood gradient; default button and frame material.

wood-mid.purpose: Middle stop of the light wood gradient.

wood-dark.purpose: Bottom stop of the light wood gradient.

wood-edge.purpose: Extruded slab edge under wood objects.

go-mid.purpose: Bottom stop of the go gradient.

gold.purpose: Selection, value, focus ring, waiting state.

cream.purpose: Text on dark wood, input fill.

sea-shallow.purpose: Centre of the radial sea canvas.

display.purpose: The hanging title sign only; white with full outline and 8px ink drop.

headline.purpose: Panel and modal titles; banner titles at 36px.

title.purpose: Turn name, big buttons, phase button.

button.purpose: All standard buttons, with small ink outline.

numeral.purpose: Resource counts, tile badges, float numbers; always tabular.

body.purpose: Panel copy and hint bar; help paragraphs capped at 62ch.

body-strong.purpose: Chips, segments, toasts, tooltips, stat rows.

label.purpose: Uppercase labels that name a control or field.

shadows.name: slab-edge
shadows.purpose: Extruded underside of pressable objects, in the material own dark tone (3 to 8px by size).

shadows.name: ambient-sea
shadows.purpose: Soft sea-tinted shadow under raised objects.

shadows.name: ambient-sea-high
shadows.purpose: Dice tray and banner, the highest objects.

shadows.name: top-lit-bevel
shadows.purpose: Lip highlight and bottom shade on buttons and plaques.

shadows.name: plank-inlay
shadows.purpose: Carved double border inside wooden boards.

shadows.name: gold-halo

shadows.name: outline

motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: press

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Carved Tabletop"**

Juräa Frontiers is a board game you could pick up: chunky cardboard hex tiles with visible thickness, floating on a cartoon teal sea, framed by carved wooden planks with iron rivets and round stone buttons. Everything is drawn in code as SVG, and every shape carries the same thick dark-umber outline, so the board art, the faction crests, the icons and the HUD read as one hand-inked object. The register is Catan's tabletop crossed with Kingdom Rush's chunky cartoon: saturated, friendly, never grim, even when the subject is necromancers.

The board is the screen. The HUD floats over it as a few physical objects (a wooden top plank, a player ledger, a tray of ability cards, one big green phase button), each with an extruded edge that sits it on the table. Reading surfaces (panels, modals, tooltips) are dark-stained wood so cream text holds its contrast; action surfaces are light wood, grass-green or stone. Faction colour does the identifying work everywhere: tile rings, crests, flags, dice, the ribbon banner, the active phase pill.

Motion is staged, physical and springy. Tiles drop and squash into place, badges pop with overshoot, banners swing in on a bounce and fly out with an ease-in, dice tumble, slam, and resolve. Every timing flows through one speed scalar and every animation stops under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One ink: dark umber (#2b1d14) outlines on every drawn shape, 2.4 to 5 units in SVG, 2 to 4px in CSS.
Three materials: carved wood (frames, primary surfaces), speckled stone (secondary controls, resource plaques), and painted cardboard (tiles).
Extruded edges, not floating shadows: every raised object shows its own darker underside, then a soft sea-blue ambient shadow.
Display type is Lilita One with a stamped ink outline; UI type is Fredoka.
Saturated terrain and faction colours over a teal radial sea.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every drawn shape, CSS or SVG, is outlined in Umber Ink (#2b1d14). Never pure black, never a faction colour, never omitted on a raised object.

rules.name: The Faction Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Violet, gold and crimson mean a faction and nothing else. Generic UI never borrows them; UI emphasis uses Coin Gold or Grass Go Green.

rules.name: The Dark Stain Rule
rules.body: Any wood surface that carries paragraphs is stained dark; light wood carries only display-type labels with an ink outline.

rules.name: The Stamped Outline Rule
rules.body: Display type on any coloured or wooden surface carries the ink outline text-shadow (small: 1.5px ring plus 2.5px drop; full: 2px ring plus 4px drop). Fredoka body text never does.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes during play (resources, troops, stats, amounts) is tabular.

rules.name: The Slab Rule
rules.body: Anything you can press has a visible underside in its own darker tone, and pressing it sinks it into that underside. Flat clickable surfaces do not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Sea Shadow Rule
rules.body: Ambient shadows are tinted toward the sea (rgba(8, 30, 52)), never neutral grey.

dos: **Do** outline every drawn shape in Umber Ink (#2b1d14): 3 to 4px on major CSS objects, 2 to 2.5px on small ones, 2.4 to 5 units in SVG.
**Do** give every pressable object a slab edge in its own darker material tone and sink it on press (translateY 4px, edge to 1px).
**Do** stain wood dark (stained-wood tokens) wherever it carries body text.
**Do** set display text in Lilita One, white or gold, with the stamped ink outline.
**Do** let faction colour identify ownership: rings, crests, flags, dice, banner, active phase step.

**Do** animate with the bounce curve (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)) for arrivals and the out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for settles, routed through the motion speed scalar and skipped under reduced motion.
**Do** author new icons and art as inline SVG in the same outlined, filled cartoon style.
donts: **Don't** use pure black, grey shadows or a faction colour as an outline.
**Don't** use violet, gold-yellow #f0b928 or crimson for generic UI; they belong to the Death Cults, Evergarden and the Giants.
**Don't** build flat, borderless, gridded strategy-app panels or a sidebar of stats; HUD pieces are physical objects floating over the board.
**Don't** cut wooden boards with identical uniform radii; vary the elliptical radii and grain offset per board.
**Don't** put Fredoka paragraphs on light wood or give body text the stamped outline.
**Don't** add icon fonts, emoji or outline-only icon sets.
**Don't** add linear-eased one-shot motion; linear timing is for looping texture only (coast dashes, marching target rings, dice tumble).
